integrity: The theorem and the polynomial coefficient bounds are proved in the provided result, with separately executable finite tests; finite computations do not establish the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: The sharp formula is restricted to weights congruent to three modulo four and indices divisible by eight. No assertion is made for the excluded boundary, other odd weights, or odd primes; independent priority and proof review remain unperformed.
title: Quadratic dyadic contact for an odd-weight binomial-square transform
